The disclosure relates to a communication method and system that integrates 5G communication technology with Internet of Things (IoT) technology. By combining the high-speed, low-latency, and high-capacity characteristics of 5G networks with the connectivity and data exchange capabilities of IoT devices, the disclosed technology enables efficient communication among a wide range of devices, terminals, and network infrastructure.

The technology may be used to support various intelligent services. Examples include smart home services, in which household appliances and sensors communicate with one another; smart city services, such as traffic control, public infrastructure monitoring, and environmental sensing; connected car services that require reliable vehicle-to-network or vehicle-to-vehicle communication; healthcare services involving remote monitoring or medical devices; digital education services; smart retail systems; and safety or security services that depend on real-time data transmission and response.

In particular, the disclosed method is applicable to the transmission and reception of signals in a mobile communication system. Within such a system, a terminal, such as a user equipment device, communicates with a network entity, such as a base station, using reference signals and related configuration information. These reference signals may be used for purposes such as channel estimation, synchronization, beam management, signal quality measurement, or other communication procedures required to maintain reliable wireless communication.

According to the disclosed method, the terminal receives information related to a first reference signal from the network. The received information may include one or more parameters associated with the first reference signal, such as sequence information identifying or defining a signal sequence, antenna port information indicating one or more antenna ports used for transmission, or transmission power information indicating the power level or power-related configuration for the reference signal.

After receiving this information, the terminal receives the first reference signal based on the provided configuration. By using the sequence, antenna port, transmission power, or other related information, the terminal can properly identify, detect, and process the first reference signal. This enables improved signal reception and supports reliable communication in a 5G-based IoT mobile communication environment.
outputs.L4:
A 5G and Internet of Things (IoT) mobile communication method and system are provided for supporting efficient transmission and reception of reference signals in a wireless communication network. In the described method, a terminal, such as a user equipment, IoT device, sensor, vehicle terminal, or other wireless device, receives configuration information from a base station or network node. The configuration information may include at least one of information associated with a reference signal sequence, information identifying one or more antenna ports used for transmitting the reference signal, and information indicating transmission power or power control parameters for the reference signal.

The reference signal sequence information may specify how the reference signal is generated, including a sequence identifier, scrambling parameter, cyclic shift, resource allocation, time-domain position, frequency-domain position, or other sequence-related parameters. The antenna port information may indicate which antenna port or antenna port group is associated with the reference signal, allowing the terminal to distinguish reference signals transmitted through different beams, layers, transmission points, or multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) configurations. The transmission power information may indicate an absolute or relative power level, a power offset, or a relationship between the reference signal power and another downlink or uplink signal.

After receiving the configuration information, the terminal uses the indicated parameters to receive, identify, and process the corresponding reference signal. The reference signal may be used for channel estimation, beam measurement, synchronization, demodulation, mobility management, radio resource management, positioning, or link quality measurement. By applying the configured sequence, antenna port, and/or power information, the terminal can more accurately detect the reference signal and determine channel conditions between the terminal and the network.

The system may include a network device configured to generate and transmit the configuration information and to transmit the reference signal according to the configured parameters. The terminal may include a receiver, processor, and memory configured to obtain the configuration information, determine the appropriate reference signal characteristics, and perform reception and measurement of the reference signal. The configuration information may be delivered through higher-layer signaling, control signaling, broadcast signaling, dedicated signaling, or a combination thereof.

This approach improves reliability and efficiency in 5G and IoT communication environments, particularly where devices may operate with different antenna capabilities, low power requirements, high mobility, or dense deployment conditions. By enabling flexible configuration of reference signal sequences, antenna ports, and transmission power, the method supports enhanced channel estimation, improved beamforming performance, reduced interference, and more accurate measurements. As a result, the described technique contributes to improved signal transmission and reception for intelligent 5G services and IoT applications, including smart cities, industrial automation, connected vehicles, remote monitoring, and massive machine-type communications.

**The Internet Generation**

The Internet Generation has grown up in a world where information, communication, and entertainment are always within reach. For many people today, the internet is not just a tool but a natural part of daily life. It is used for studying, working, shopping, watching videos, playing games, and staying connected with friends and family.

One of the greatest advantages of the internet is access to knowledge. Students can find articles, videos, online courses, and digital libraries in seconds. This has changed the way people learn, making education more flexible and available to many. The internet also helps people share ideas across countries and cultures, creating new opportunities for cooperation and creativity.

However, the Internet Generation also faces challenges. Spending too much time online can affect health, social skills, and concentration. Social media can create pressure to look perfect or compare one’s life with others. In addition, misinformation spreads quickly, so it is important to think critically and check sources before believing or sharing information.

The internet has shaped a generation that is fast, connected, and informed. To use it well, people need balance, responsibility, and digital awareness. When used wisely, the internet can be a powerful force for learning, communication, and positive change.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style disclosure summary for a 5G/IoT mobile communication invention involving a terminal receiving reference signal configuration information such as sequence, antenna port, and transmission power.
counterfactuals.output:
A mobile communication method, apparatus, and system are disclosed for supporting reference signal transmission and reception in a 5G/New Radio (NR), LTE-advanced, or Internet of Things (IoT) wireless communication environment. A terminal device receives, from a base station, reference signal configuration information associated with at least one reference signal to be transmitted or measured in a serving cell or neighboring cell. The reference signal configuration information may include one or more of: a reference signal sequence configuration, an antenna port configuration, a resource allocation configuration, a time/frequency transmission pattern, a subcarrier spacing, a transmission bandwidth, a beam or spatial domain indication, and transmission power-related information.

In one embodiment, the terminal receives signaling indicating a reference signal sequence or a parameter used to generate the sequence, such as a scrambling identifier, cyclic shift, initialization value, comb offset, or sequence index. The terminal further receives information identifying one or more antenna ports associated with transmission of the reference signal. The antenna port information may be used by the terminal to distinguish quasi-co-located signals, determine channel characteristics, perform beam management, estimate channel state information, or demodulate downlink or uplink data.

The transmission power-related information may include an absolute transmission power value, a power offset relative to another signal or channel, a power control parameter, a power boosting value, or an indication of whether the reference signal is transmitted with a predetermined or dynamically configured power level. Based on the received transmission power information, the terminal may estimate path loss, determine channel quality, perform radio resource management measurements, or adjust uplink transmission power.

The reference signal may comprise one or more of a channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS), demodulation reference signal (DMRS), sounding reference signal (SRS), tracking reference signal (TRS), positioning reference signal (PRS), synchronization signal block reference signal, or an IoT-specific narrowband reference signal. The reference signal configuration information may be provided through broadcast signaling, system information, radio resource control signaling, medium access control control elements, downlink control information, or a combination thereof.

According to an aspect of the disclosure, the terminal determines, based on the received reference signal configuration information, resources on which the reference signal is to be received or transmitted. The terminal may then perform reference signal reception, channel estimation, synchronization, beam selection, positioning, mobility measurement, or uplink sounding according to the configured sequence, antenna port, and transmission power parameters.

A base station apparatus is also disclosed. The base station generates reference signal configuration information including at least one of sequence information, antenna port information, and transmission power information, transmits the configuration information to the terminal, and transmits or receives the corresponding reference signal according to the configuration. The disclosed configuration mechanism enables flexible reference signal operation for massive machine-type communications, ultra-reliable low-latency communications, enhanced mobile broadband, and other 5G/IoT services while reducing signaling overhead and improving measurement accuracy, beam management performance, and power control efficiency.

### Patent-Style Description

A method performed by a terminal in a mobile communication system is provided. The method includes obtaining, from a network entity, information related to at least one of a reference signal sequence, an antenna port, or transmission power for a reference signal; identifying, based on the obtained information, a configuration for receiving the reference signal; and receiving the reference signal from the network entity according to the identified configuration.

In an embodiment, the information related to the reference signal sequence includes at least one of a sequence identifier, a scrambling identifier, an initialization value, a cyclic shift value, an orthogonal cover code, or a resource configuration associated with generation or mapping of the reference signal sequence.

In an embodiment, the information related to the antenna port includes an antenna port index, a set of antenna ports, a quasi co-location configuration, spatial relation information, beam information, or a mapping relationship between the reference signal and one or more antenna ports.

In an embodiment, the information related to the transmission power includes at least one of a power offset, a power control parameter, a reference signal power value, a power boosting value, or information indicating a relationship between transmission power of the reference signal and transmission power of another signal or channel.

In an embodiment, the terminal receives the information through higher layer signaling, downlink control information, system information, radio resource control signaling, a medium access control control element, or a combination thereof.

In an embodiment, the reference signal includes at least one of a demodulation reference signal, a channel state information reference signal, a phase tracking reference signal, a sounding reference signal, a positioning reference signal, or a synchronization signal block reference signal.

---

### Example Independent Claim

1. A method performed by a terminal in a mobile communication system, the method comprising:  
   obtaining information related to at least one of a reference signal sequence, an antenna port, or transmission power associated with a reference signal;  
   determining, based on the obtained information, a reception configuration for the reference signal; and  
   receiving the reference signal according to the reception configuration.

### Example Dependent Claims

3. The method of claim 1, wherein the information related to the antenna port comprises at least one of an antenna port index, a plurality of antenna port indices, quasi co-location information, transmission configuration indication information, beam information, or spatial relation information.

4. The method of claim 1, wherein the information related to the transmission power comprises at least one of a reference signal power value, a power offset value, a power boosting indication, or a power control parameter.

5. The method of claim 1, wherein the obtaining of the information comprises receiving the information from a base station through at least one of radio resource control signaling, medium access control signaling, downlink control information, or system information.

6. The method of claim 1, wherein the reference signal comprises at least one of a demodulation reference signal, a channel state information reference signal, a phase tracking reference signal, a positioning reference signal, or a sounding reference signal.

## Patent Specification Excerpt

### Title  
**Method and Apparatus for Receiving Reference Signals in a Fifth-Generation Wireless Communication System Supporting Internet-of-Things Services**

### Technical Field  
The present disclosure relates to wireless communication systems and, more particularly, to a method and apparatus for receiving a reference signal by a terminal in a fifth-generation (5G) wireless communication system supporting Internet-of-Things (IoT) services, based on configuration parameters received from a network entity.

### Background  
In a 5G wireless communication system, a terminal may receive one or more types of reference signals for purposes including synchronization, channel estimation, beam management, radio resource management, positioning, and demodulation. In IoT environments, terminals may be power-limited, intermittently connected, or configured for reduced-capability operation. Accordingly, efficient configuration and reception of reference signals are required to reduce power consumption and signaling overhead while maintaining reliable communication.

Reference signals may be transmitted periodically, semi-persistently, or aperiodically, and may be associated with specific time-domain resources, frequency-domain resources, numerologies, beam identifiers, antenna ports, or transmission configuration indication states. A terminal may receive configuration parameters from a base station and may determine, based on the received configuration parameters, occasions and resources on which the reference signal is to be monitored.

### Summary  
According to an aspect of the present disclosure, a method performed by a terminal in a wireless communication system is provided. The method includes receiving, from a base station, configuration information including one or more parameters for reception of a reference signal; determining, based on the configuration information, at least one reference signal reception occasion; and receiving the reference signal on a radio resource corresponding to the at least one reference signal reception occasion.

According to another aspect of the present disclosure, the configuration information may include at least one of a reference signal resource identifier, a periodicity, an offset, a duration, a frequency-domain allocation, a subcarrier spacing, a cyclic prefix configuration, a beam-related parameter, an antenna port indication, a quasi co-location parameter, a power control parameter, or an activation indication.

According to yet another aspect of the present disclosure, the terminal may be an IoT terminal, a reduced-capability terminal, a machine-type communication terminal, or a terminal configured for low-power operation. The terminal may selectively monitor the reference signal based on an operational state, a discontinuous reception configuration, or an energy-saving parameter included in or associated with the configuration information.

### Detailed Description  

In an embodiment, a wireless communication system includes a base station and at least one terminal. The base station may be a next-generation Node B (gNB), a transmission reception point (TRP), an access point, or another network node configured to provide radio access. The terminal may be user equipment (UE), an IoT device, a sensor device, an actuator, a wearable device, an industrial terminal, or a reduced-capability 5G terminal.

The base station transmits configuration information to the terminal. The configuration information may be transmitted through radio resource control (RRC) signaling, medium access control control element (MAC CE) signaling, downlink control information (DCI), system information, or a combination thereof. The configuration information may configure one or more reference signal resources for the terminal.

The reference signal may include, for example, a channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS), a synchronization signal block (SSB), a demodulation reference signal (DM-RS), a tracking reference signal (TRS), a positioning reference signal (PRS), a phase tracking reference signal (PT-RS), or another signal usable by the terminal for measurement, synchronization, positioning, channel estimation, beam selection, or link maintenance.

In one embodiment, the configuration information includes a reference signal resource set. The reference signal resource set may include a plurality of reference signal resources, each resource being associated with at least one resource identifier. A reference signal resource may be defined by time-domain information and frequency-domain information. The time-domain information may include a slot index, symbol index, periodicity, offset, repetition factor, or duration. The frequency-domain information may include a bandwidth, resource block allocation, comb pattern, subcarrier offset, or frequency hopping parameter.

The terminal determines a reference signal reception occasion using the received configuration parameters. For example, when the configuration information includes a periodicity and an offset, the terminal may determine that a reference signal reception occasion occurs in a slot satisfying a predetermined relationship between a slot number, the periodicity, and the offset. The terminal may then activate a receiver circuit during the determined occasion and receive the reference signal on the configured time-frequency resource.

In another embodiment, the configuration information includes beam-related information. The beam-related information may include a beam identifier, spatial relation information, transmission configuration indication (TCI) state, quasi co-location (QCL) information, or an indication of an associated SSB or CSI-RS resource. The terminal may configure a receive beam or spatial filter based on the beam-related information before receiving the reference signal.

In still another embodiment, the terminal operates in a low-power IoT mode. In the low-power IoT mode, the terminal may refrain from monitoring reference signal resources not indicated as active by the received configuration information. The terminal may receive an activation or deactivation indication from the base station, and may monitor only activated reference signal resources. This operation reduces unnecessary receiver activation and thereby reduces power consumption.

The terminal may further perform at least one measurement on the received reference signal. The measurement may include reference signal received power (RSRP), reference signal received quality (RSRQ), signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR), channel quality indicator (CQI), beam quality, timing offset, Doppler shift, delay spread, or positioning-related measurement. The terminal may report the measurement result to the base station according to reporting configuration information received from the base station.

In an embodiment, when the terminal receives a plurality of reference signal configurations, the terminal may select one of the plurality of configurations based on priority information, serving cell information, bandwidth part information, power-saving state, mobility state, or a scheduling indication. The selected configuration may be used to determine a reference signal reception occasion.

In another embodiment, the terminal may receive reference signal configuration information associated with a bandwidth part. When the active bandwidth part of the terminal changes, the terminal may determine whether the configured reference signal resource is within the active bandwidth part. If the configured reference signal resource is not within the active bandwidth part, the terminal may suspend reception of the reference signal or may receive updated configuration information.

### Example Method  

A method performed by a terminal may include the following operations:

1. receiving, from a base station, configuration information for a reference signal, the configuration information including at least one of a periodicity, an offset, a resource identifier, a frequency-domain allocation, a beam indication, or an activation indication;

2. determining, based on the configuration information, a time-frequency resource on which the reference signal is expected to be transmitted;

3. configuring at least one receiver parameter based on the configuration information, the at least one receiver parameter including a receive beam, bandwidth part, subcarrier spacing, or antenna port assumption;

4. receiving the reference signal on the determined time-frequency resource; and

5. performing a measurement, synchronization operation, channel estimation operation, beam management operation, or positioning operation based on the received reference signal.

### Apparatus  

A terminal according to an embodiment includes a transceiver and at least one processor operably coupled to the transceiver. The at least one processor is configured to control the transceiver to receive, from a base station, configuration information including one or more parameters associated with reference signal reception; determine, based on the configuration information, a reference signal reception occasion and a radio resource corresponding thereto; and control the transceiver to receive a reference signal on the determined radio resource.

The at least one processor may be further configured to deactivate at least a portion of the transceiver outside the determined reference signal reception occasion. The at least one processor may also be configured to perform a measurement on the reference signal and transmit a report including a result of the measurement to the base station.

### Claims Excerpt  

1. **A method performed by a terminal in a wireless communication system, the method comprising:**  
   receiving, from a base station, configuration information including one or more parameters for reception of a reference signal;  
   determining, based on the configuration information, a reference signal reception occasion; and  
   receiving the reference signal on a radio resource corresponding to the reference signal reception occasion.

2. **The method of claim 1,** wherein the one or more parameters include at least one of a reference signal resource identifier, a periodicity, an offset, a time-domain allocation, a frequency-domain allocation, a subcarrier spacing, a beam indication, an antenna port indication, or quasi co-location information.

3. **The method of claim 1,** wherein the reference signal comprises at least one of a channel state information reference signal, a synchronization signal block, a tracking reference signal, a positioning reference signal, a demodulation reference signal, or a phase tracking reference signal.

4. **The method of claim 1,** further comprising configuring a receive beam of the terminal based on beam-related information included in the configuration information.

5. **The method of claim 1,** further comprising performing a measurement on the received reference signal and transmitting, to the base station, a report including a result of the measurement.

6. **The method of claim 1,** wherein the terminal is an Internet-of-Things terminal or a reduced-capability terminal, and wherein the terminal activates a receiver circuit during the reference signal reception occasion and deactivates the receiver circuit outside the reference signal reception occasion.

7. **A terminal comprising:**  
   a transceiver; and  
   at least one processor coupled to the transceiver,  
   wherein the at least one processor is configured to:  
   receive, from a base station through the transceiver, configuration information including one or more parameters for reception of a reference signal;  
   determine, based on the configuration information, a reference signal reception occasion; and  
   control the transceiver to receive the reference signal on a radio resource corresponding to the reference signal reception occasion.

8. **The terminal of claim 7,** wherein the at least one processor is further configured to determine the reference signal reception occasion based on a periodicity and an offset included in the configuration information.

9. **The terminal of claim 7,** wherein the configuration information includes activation information indicating whether a configured reference signal resource is active.

10. **A non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing instructions that, when executed by at least one processor of a terminal, cause the terminal to perform the method of claim 1.**
